title: Machine-dependent natural number
statement: For a finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean alphabet and natural numbers $k$ and $c$, define $E(N,k,c)=k+c+1+2C(N)+\bigl(|Q|+2+9t\bigr)$, where $C(N)$ is the code parameter of $N$, $Q$ is its finite state set, and $t$ is its number of work tapes.
hypotheses_covered: N is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean alphabet
